properties.name: Low Island
properties.description: One of 83 San Juan Islands National Wildlife Refuge islands. You may see black oystercatchers, rhinoceros auklets, glaucous-winged gulls, cormorants, pigeon guillemots, and tufted puffins. Stay 200 yard away.
